card.name: Start of a word after a hyphen
card.fires_on: The first piece of a word right after a hyphen or opening mark, especially after non- or anti-, where the word repeats a term seen earlier. It also fires on the first letter of a repeated term after a slash or parenthesis.

modes.label: After non- or anti-
modes.description: Hyphen plus the first letters of a negated or opposing term that repeats an earlier word.

modes.label: Start of a repeated term
modes.description: First letter of a term that restates the one just before it, after a slash or opening bracket.

card.plain: It marks the start of a word that echoes a term just seen, often after non- or anti-.
